teacher_info.about_teacher:
As a teacher, I think what is most important for me is to create a warm and relaxing environment for my students, where students feel that it is OK to make mistakes. That is really important, because making mistakes is how we learn anything new. No-one is perfect from the start, however much they want to be (and as a language student myself, I know how that feels).
In essence, I take my job seriously, but not myself.
Everyone wants to speak perfectly and avoid mistakes,but the goal of language is to communicate. If you can understand and be understood, who cares if you make a mistake? So, my motto is: COMMUNICATION IS GREAT, PERFECTION CAN WAIT!

I moved to South Korea in 2014 to teach in the school system there and after returning to Europe, I now live full time in France; trying to create a sustainable, environmentally friendly life, which currently focusses on my straw bale house..

I have taught online since 2011 and I love the opportunities it offers. I am also truly fond of meeting people and learning about new cultures from all over the world. In fact traveling around the word everyday is one of my favourite parts of working online; I can start my day in Japan and then jump from there to say, Argentina or Russia and everywhere in between! 

In terms of qualifications, I have a TEFL certificate alongside classroom-based experience in a private language school in Guangdong, China, and in the state school system in Naju, South Korea. Degree-wise, have a BA in Marketing and European Cultural Studies and an MA in Public Management. 

Since moving to France, I have taught students of varying abilities online with a main focus on improving their fluency and flow. Examinations have also been a theme of my teaching and I have helped students through all sorts of exams including IELTS, CAE and CPE. Writing is also an area of specialty for me; from proofreading to literature. 

I really enjoy helping students to improve their own English skills in a relaxed environment. Language naturally flows better if everyone involved is relaxed; this is what I strive for with my lessons, natural conversation guided by certain topics, idioms and exercises. I generally offer structured lessons/packages which also focus on language skills, not only the bare bones of English.

My personal interests include; mountaineering, yoga, photography, protecting the environment, living sustainably and enjoying life. My classes generally focus on these areas, although I also love learning about new or unusual aspects of life.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I am a DELTA-qualified English teacher fluent in German with experience both in the UK and Germany. I have worked with learners of many different backgrounds, but I most often work with German speakers as I can help them understand the differences between English and German. 
My courses and lessons are clearly focussed and structured, but they are also friendly and relaxed. As well as working on vocabulary and grammar, I focus on developing skills and speaking practice so my clients feel confident using English in new situations.
I understand the importance of appearing professional if you use English at work, so from day one my business English lessons focus on situations in your job.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching approach is goal-oriented. In our first session, we will discuss your goals and experience, so I can create a personalised learning plan for you. Whatever your aims, active practice and speaking will play an important part in our lessons. 
After each lesson, you will receive notes and a vocabulary list with new words. I'll also give you lots of tips on how to practise outside our classes.
You can decide how much homework you would like, but for conversation lessons, I often send my students an article or video to prepare before our lesson.
